noise.selection: All files from seven named non-speech training categories and two held-out categories. Both members of every decoded-PCM duplicate excluded; category labels are not perceptual certification.

split_policy: Held-out Rasa language groups and disjoint MS-SNSD categories before cropping/mixing. No explicit speaker IDs: true person-disjointness across languages is not established.
